summary: Iteration 3 covers the new landing quiz on /contact, the /studio 3D recorder page, the RainJourney3D homepage hero, and the admin dashboard expandable lead detail with scoping fields + photos. Frontend E2E fully passed. Backend was already smoke-tested by main agent (POST /api/upload, GET /api/files/{path}, POST /api/leads with new fields, GET /api/leads as admin). E2E verified persistence: the TEST_Landing_Quiz lead created via UI shows source='landing', all scoping fields, and 1 uploaded photo thumbnail in the admin detail panel.

issues: (Carry-over from iteration 2) Stats card icon/number contrast is very dim — number '2' in Total leads/Last 7 days is barely readable on the dark surface.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Improve stats card contrast on /admin (see iteration 2).
critical_code_review_comments: AssessmentQuiz.jsx: uploading state is derived from photos array — correct; Continue button correctly disabled while any photo status==='uploading'. Verified during E2E.
AssessmentQuiz.jsx pickSingle uses a 260ms advancing lock via useRef — good against double-tap; back+forward preserves single-selection state (verified).

Contact validation email regex is basic (`^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`) — acceptable for a lead form; server-side Pydantic should still validate. Consider EmailStr on backend LeadCreate for defense-in-depth.

Studio.jsx uses canvas.captureStream(60) + MediaRecorder — browser support varies (Safari lacks vp9). The MIME fallback to 'video/webm' is present. If Safari support required, add MP4 fallback or feature-detect and disable button with a tooltip.
AdminDashboard.jsx: LeadDetail correctly excludes empty scoping fields; photos rendered via fileUrl(). Row expand uses onClick with stopPropagation on Contact/Status cells — good UX.
AssessmentQuiz photo cap of 6 is enforced client-side only (slice(0, 6-photos.length)). Server should also enforce max file count/size per lead to avoid abuse (open POST /api/upload).

POST /api/upload is public/unauthenticated — this is required for the landing form but means the endpoint can be abused for arbitrary image hosting. Consider: (a) content-type + magic-byte validation, (b) file size cap, (c) rate limiting by IP.
Loader intro (~1.8s) blocks page interactions; tests must wait for `[data-testid=intro-loader]` to detach before clicking. Not a bug, just a testability note.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 landing lead via frontend E2E: name='TEST Landing Quiz', email=test_uoybbkwv@example.com, phone=3865551234, source=landing, 1 photo (/tmp/test_flood.png 1x1 PNG). Verified persisted and visible in /admin under Landing filter with expanded scoping fields + photo thumbnail (id=7a6981ea-214d-4cf4-adeb-9e29d4bcabf1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Intro loader curtain must be dismissed (~1.8s) before quiz interactions — wait for `[data-testid=intro-loader]` state='detached'. The photo file input is `class=hidden` and only reachable via `page.set_input_files` (not visible-click). Admin login flow unchanged. Landing filter button label is 'Landing'. 3D RainJourney3D actually renders in headless — no crash observed. Backend URL from frontend/.env only; do not hardcode.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Initial test failure was a testing artefact (intro loader intercepting clicks); resolved by waiting for loader detach before interacting.
